audience.text: Python developers building applications that require programmatic Excel workbook manipulation, especially those needing a permissively licensed, pure-Python solution.

capabilities.text: The library supports loading and saving Excel .xlsx files using the Workbook class.
capabilities.title: Read and write .xlsx workbooks

capabilities.text: Cells can be accessed by A1 reference and assigned values or formulas; cached results are preserved.
capabilities.title: Cell value and formula handling

capabilities.text: Apply fonts, fills, borders, alignment, and number formats to cells using the Style and Font classes.
capabilities.title: Styling and formatting

capabilities.text: Supports data validation lists, auto-filters, conditional formatting, and comments.
capabilities.title: Data validation and conditional features

capabilities.text: Create and preserve charts, pictures, shapes, tables, and sparklines.
capabilities.title: Chart and object support

capabilities.text: Export workbooks to CSV, TSV, JSON, Markdown, and PDF using appropriate save options.
capabilities.title: Export to multiple formats

capabilities.text: Supports password-based encryption and decryption of .xlsx files using standard and agile encryption.
capabilities.title: Encryption and protection

limitations.text: Formula expressions and cached results are preserved, but this project is not a full Excel calculation engine.
Native workbook loading and saving targets the Open XML .xlsx format; other spreadsheet formats such as .xls, .ods, and .xlsb are not supported.
Some advanced Excel features are preserved as source package parts rather than exposed as editable Python objects.
PDF output depends on locally available fonts and the optional skia-python renderer.

problems_solved.text: Enables Excel workbook generation and editing in pure Python without Microsoft Excel or Windows COM dependencies.
Supports password-protected .xlsx files for secure data handling.
Provides export to multiple formats including CSV, TSV, JSON, Markdown, and PDF.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Cells FOSS for Python is a free, open-source, pure-Python library for creating, reading, modifying, and exporting Excel .xlsx workbooks without requiring Microsoft Excel.

uncertainties: The exact set of formats supported for input beyond .xlsx is not explicitly listed beyond CSV.
Whether TSV export is supported directly or only via CSV export is not confirmed by facts.
The behavior of preserving unsupported workbook parts during load/save round trips is described but not detailed.
The scope of formula calculation support (e.g., evaluation vs. preservation) is not fully clarified.
Whether all chart types are fully modifiable or only preserved is not specified beyond presence of chart symbols.
The extent of conditional formatting support beyond what is listed is not detailed.
The behavior of data validation when loading non-.xlsx formats is not addressed.
Whether the package supports streaming or in-memory operations without file I/O is not confirmed.

workflows.name: Read and modify existing workbooks
